description: Implementation of the D3D9 IndexBuffer class for managing index buffers in Direct3D 9 within the ANGLE project.

classes.name: IndexBuffer9
classes.description: Class implementing index buffer management for Direct3D 9 in ANGLE.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Allocates and initializes the index buffer with specified size, type, and dynamic flag.

methods.name: mapBuffer
methods.description: Maps the index buffer for writing, returning a pointer to the mapped memory.

methods.name: unmapBuffer
methods.description: Unmaps the index buffer after writing.

methods.name: getIndexType
methods.description: Returns the type of indices stored in the buffer.

methods.name: getBufferSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the index buffer.

methods.name: setSize
methods.description: Resizes the index buffer if needed, based on new size and type.

methods.name: discard
methods.description: Discards the current contents of the index buffer.

methods.name: getIndexFormat
methods.description: Returns the D3D format corresponding to the index type.
